text: {"fields":[{"name":"Restricted jurisdictions","found":false,"value":"Not stated","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Restricted Jurisdiction); Schedule 4","quote":"\"Restricted Jurisdiction\" means each state, territory or other jurisdiction listed in Schedule 4.","note":"The definition points to Schedule 4. Schedule 4 is listed in the Schedules and Exhibits index but is not in the pack (page 61 is blank apart from the scanned Annex A), so the list cannot be extracted. Schedule 4 is also missing from the table of contents."},{"name":"Minimum liquidity covenant","found":true,"value":"US$10,000,000","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(d)","quote":"Liquidity at all times is not less than US$10,000,000, tested at the end of each calendar month.","note":"The covenant is stated as 'at all times' but is tested at the end of each calendar month. Liquidity means unrestricted cash and cash equivalents of the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries."},{"name":"Maximum leverage covenant","found":true,"value":"6.00 to 1.00","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(b)","quote":"The Leverage Ratio at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent does not exceed 6.00 to 1.00.","note":"Under Section 6.12(c), for the Leverage Ratio only, up to US$15,000,000 of Subordinated Debt is added to Tangible Net Worth and deducted from Total Liabilities. Tested on the Parent and its consolidated Subsidiaries at each fiscal quarter end."},{"name":"Minimum tangible net worth covenant","found":true,"value":"US$40,000,000","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 6.12(a)","quote":"Tangible Net Worth at the end of each fiscal quarter of the Parent is not less than US$40,000,000.","note":"The Tangible Net Worth definition says it is 'subject to Section 6.12(c)'. However, Section 6.12(c) expressly says its Subordinated Debt add-back applies 'not for the purpose of paragraph (a)'. The add-back therefore does not apply to this covenant."},{"name":"Delinquency trigger","found":true,"value":"Three-month average Delinquency Ratio exceeds 6.0%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 7.1","quote":"the average of the Delinquency Ratio for the three most recently ended Collection Periods exceeds 6.0%","note":"Delinquency Ratio (Section 1.1) is the Outstanding Balance of Pool Receivables 60 or more days past due divided by all Pool Receivables, excluding charged-off Defaulted Receivables. While the trigger continues, the Revolving Period is suspended. The 5% alert in lender_requirements is an internal monitoring threshold, not the contractual trigger."},{"name":"Reserve amount","found":true,"value":"1% of the Eligible Pool Balance","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Reserve Amount)","quote":"\"Reserve Amount\" means, on any date, an amount equal to 1% of the Eligible Pool Balance.","note":"Under the Eligible Pool Balance definition, the Reserve Amount is measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before any deduction of the Excess Concentration Amount. It is deducted after the Advance Rate is applied."},{"name":"Excess concentration treatment","found":true,"value":"Deducted from Eligible Pool Balance before Advance Rate applied","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 1.1 (definition of Borrowing Base)","quote":"(a) the Eligible Pool Balance less the Excess Concentration Amount, multiplied by (b) the Advance Rate","note":"Under the Excess Concentration Amount definition, limits are applied in the order listed in Schedule 2, and an amount excluded under one limit is not counted again under a later limit. Schedule 2 percentages are measured against the Eligible Pool Balance before the deduction."},{"name":"Concentration limits","found":true,"value":"4","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 2","quote":"Receivables secured by used Financed Vehicles","note":"Unamended position: Schedule 2 lists four limits (state 20%, single Dealer 5%, term over 72 months 25%, used vehicles 70%). Amendment No. 1 adds a fifth limit (FICO below 600: 35%) from 1 March 2026; that amendment is not applied here."},{"name":"Eligibility criteria","found":true,"value":"12","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Schedule 1","quote":"12. Unique collateral.","note":"Schedule 1 lists criteria numbered 1 to 12. Criterion 7 depends on Schedule 4 (Restricted Jurisdictions), which is not in the pack."},{"name":"Advance rate","found":true,"value":"85%","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Section 2.3","quote":"The \"Advance Rate\" means 85%.","note":"Unamended position. Amendment No. 1 replaces 85% with 82.5% from 1 March 2026; that amendment is not applied here."},{"name":"Facility limit","found":true,"value":"US$250,000,000","source_document":"credit_agreement","clause":"Annex A (Commitment Schedule)","quote":"US$250,000,000","note":"Annex A appears as a scanned page numbered 61, placed after Exhibit C, and is initialled for identification on the Closing Date. Facility Limit is defined as the Commitment in Annex A on the Closing Date, as reduced under the Agreement. Annex A is not listed in the table of contents."}]}
